x: In the six mile championship he finished within five seconds of English Native record, and 27 seconds inside previous Chamupionship best; and yet he finished fifth. The Polish runner, Noji, was successful, and Burns, Potts and Eaton earned Olympic selection.

Burns, one of our new men from Eastleigh, was most unfortunate to be disqualified in the first 50 yards. He removed his number and carried on walking and impressed us all with his speed and very fine style.

At seven miles Burns (Elswick) had increased his lead to one of over 100 yards from Holden (Tipton) and Dodd (Wirral), who were together. Penny had shaken off some of his opposition and was now sixth.
